Subject: Your ohmail trial ends in two days

ohmail.

Your trial ends in two days.

Your trial ends on 16 September 2026, 00:00 UTC. To keep ohmail organizing your mailbox, choose a subscription on your account page.

If you do nothing, ohmail stops organizing when the trial ends. Your mailbox stays yours. ohmail touches nothing in it, and everything it filed stays where it is.

Open your ohmail account:
https://app.ohmail.app/#/settings/account

Write to support@ohmail.app and a person answers.
